title: ReFrame: Evidence-Guided Test-Time Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.21100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend model capabilities beyond text, they also make safety alignment increasingly challenging. Multimodal safety alignment methods must address cross-modal jailbreaks, safety-awareness failures, and over-sensitive refusals. However, existing methods often rely on retraining or internal-state inspection, limiting their applicability to deployed closed-source MLLMs and motivating test-time safety alignment. We analyze this setting and identify two key obstacles, utility dominance and reasoning inertia, which cause models to overlook latent risks or follow malicious reasoning trajectories. Guided by these insights, we propose ReFrame, a training-free multimodal input reframing framework where two agents share a lightweight locally deployed MLLM: the evidence-generation agent constructs complementary risk and utility evidence, and the rewrite-and-routing agent converts it into a safe proxy pro

translated_title: ReFrame：多模态大语言模型中证据引导的测试时安全对齐
translated_abstract: 虽然多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）将模型能力扩展到文本之外，但它们也使安全对齐变得越来越具有挑战性。多模态安全对齐方法必须解决跨模态越狱、安全感知失败和过度敏感拒绝等问题。然而，现有方法通常依赖于重训练或内部状态检查，限制了其对已部署的闭源多模态大语言模型的适用性，并推动了测试时安全对齐的需求。我们分析了这一设置，并识别出两个关键障碍：效用主导性和推理惯性，这些导致模型忽视潜在风险或遵循恶意推理轨迹。在这些见解的指导下，我们提出了ReFrame，一种无需训练的多模态输入重构框架，其中两个代理共享一个轻量级的本地部署多模态大语言模型：证据生成代理构建互补的风险和效用证据，而重写与路由代理将其转换为安全的代理提示。
tldr: ReFrame通过证据引导的输入重构实现测试时安全对齐，无需训练或内部状态访问，有效解决多模态模型中的跨模态越狱和推理惯性问题。
en_tdlr: ReFrame achieves test-time safety alignment via evidence-guided input reframing without training or internal-state access, effectively addressing cross-modal jailbreaks and reasoning inertia in multimodal models.
